programs.title: Almost Unsolved Heists
programs.desc: In the sleepy town of Marlborough, where boredom and low pay fuel dreams of escape, a daring heist unfolds in the dead of night, sparking a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game between local detectives and an elusive international crime syndicate.

programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: Brooklin is a single mother from a prominent family when Australia's Casanova Conman roars into her life in a yellow Maserati; he lies, cheats, steals and squanders as Brooklin desperately tries to protect what matters most.

programs.title: Dream Horse
programs.desc: The true story of Dream Alliance, an unlikely racehorse bred by small-town bartender Jan Vokes. With very little money and no experience, Jan convinces her neighbors to chip in their meager earnings to help raise Dream and compete with the racing elites. Their investment pays off as Dream rises through the ranks and becomes a beacon of hope in their struggling community.

programs.title: National Anthem
programs.desc: A construction worker joins a community of queer rodeo performers searching for their own version of the American dream. While working on a ranch in the Southwest, they contend with the undeniable forces of nature, family and love.

programs.title: The Wandering Barber
programs.desc: Jeremy Regan believes places like his barber shop are public spaces of hallowed ground, to potentially understand the world better and even solve some of its biggest issues. As the barber/owner of Hunter and Gunn Barbershop in Winnipeg perhaps he is a bit biased. But to prove his theory, Jeremy hits the road, making his way to Ukraine in the midst of war to learn what local barbers are doing every day during the invasion to support those fending off the invaders. Along the way he uncovers the story of himself and the Ukrainian spirit.
